queries.text: make the agent only edit the files I name when renaming a function
queries.rationale: tip-01 limits edits to a named file list for a rename; review-01 confirms it on a function rename. tip-02 is a repo-wide rename (the opposite) and tip-22 is diff review, so both are distractors.

queries.text: stop the agent from reformatting unrelated code in my diff
queries.rationale: tip-03 and review-03 forbid drive-by formatting in agent diffs. tip-04 formats every commit, which does not keep a diff minimal.

queries.text: add a database column without the agent changing existing migrations
queries.rationale: tip-05 scopes a column change to one new migration and forbids editing old ones. tip-06 squashes migrations and tip-21 adds rollbacks; neither answers the scoping question.

queries.text: separate Postgres database for each git worktree so parallel agent tests don't collide
queries.rationale: tip-07 and review-07 give each worktree its own database. tip-18 covers worktrees without databases, tip-08 shares one database, and hidden-01/review-h1 are ineligible.

queries.text: agent says mix: command not found but it works in my terminal
queries.rationale: tip-09 explains the non-interactive shell PATH problem; review-09 quotes the same error and fix. tip-10 pins versions but does not fix PATH.

queries.text: find the first real error in a huge failing test log instead of summarizing all of it
queries.rationale: long-01 states the technique at its beginning, before 30 KB of pytest output; tip-13 is the short form. tip-17 and long-04 are log-related distractors.

queries.text: agent runs out of context reading 20,000 lines of build output
queries.rationale: long-02 is a review whose fix (redirect to build.log and grep) sits in the middle of pasted build output; tip-14 states the same technique briefly. long-05 is unrelated long output.

queries.text: should my question go before or after a long pasted stack trace?
queries.rationale: long-03 gives the answer only at its end, after a long trace; review-l3 confirms it. tip-23 is about quoting error strings, not prompt order.

queries.text: ** (Mix) could not compile dependency :bcrypt_elixir, "mix compile" failed.
queries.rationale: tip-15 and review-15 contain this exact error and its fix. tip-16 is a different NIF build failure; deleted-01 is ineligible.

queries.text: (DBConnection.ConnectionError) connection not available and request was dropped from queue after 2000ms
queries.rationale: tip-19 explains this exact queue timeout. tip-20 is the different FATAL too-many-clients error and review-08 mentions connection limits only in passing.
